summary: Workload VMs can use NetApp Cloud Volumes Service volumes as NFS mount points or SMB shares.
extended_definition: Workload VMs can use NetApp Cloud Volumes Service volumes as NFS mount points or SMB shares.

supporting_pages.title: "Workload VM backup solutions \_|\_ Google Cloud VMware Engine \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: The performance tiers of Google Cloud NetApp Volumes are dynamic and a volume can be upgraded to a higher tier during recovery to meet your RTO and then changed to a lower tier to optimize costs.
Use Google Cloud NetApp Volumes to export NFS and SMB volumes for use as backup repositories.
Google Cloud NetApp Volumes are regional, and data is not replicated across zones or regions.

supporting_pages.title: "Mount backup images of Compute Engine instances in the appliance management\
evidence_snippets: From Select Volumes To Mount , select a single volume or multiple volumes to attach to the existing instance.
From Select Volumes To Mount , select a single volume or multiple volumes to mount.

Impact of mounting instances where disks are encrypted with CMEK If you are mounting a Compute Engine instance that has attached disks that are encrypted with Customer Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK), then be aware of the following: The mounted disks are encrypted with the same key version that the selected snapshot of the disks is encrypted with.
